attempts.error: Cloud Storage connector returned a manifest map; the workflow incorrectly accessed a body field.
attempts.fix: Read the connector result as the JSON manifest map.

attempts.error: The JSON manifest map was incorrectly passed to text.decode, which requires bytes.
attempts.fix: Use the JSON map returned by the Storage connector directly.

attempts.error: The Workflow identity could invoke Cloud Run but lacked run.operations.get to wait for the returned operation. The error path started a release job while acquisition was still running.
attempts.fix: Grant the Workflow identity a project-scoped custom role containing only run.operations.get; retain job-scoped roles/run.developer for invocation. The Workflow now waits for Cloud Run operations before continuing.
